data.name: Solo Oasis : Unlimited Places
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO SOLO OASIS : UNLIMITED PLACES, A MINIMALIST WALKING SIMULATOR THAT TAKES YOU THROUGH A FEVER DREAM OF EXPERIENCES.

WALK FROM ROOM TO ROOM AND EXPLORE THE WORLD OF SOLO OASIS.

USE WASD TO MOVE, MOUSE TO LOOK, LEFT and RIGHT CLICK to INTERACT.

XBOX CONTROLS: LEFT STICK to MOVE, RIGHT STICK to LOOK, A and B to INTERACT

WALK TO THE EDGE TO GO TO A NEW ROOM

MADE WITH LOVE FOR SOUPJAM 2026, A SMALL 3 MONTH GAME JAM CENTERED AROUND A TYPE OF MINIMALIST ART GAME CALLED A SOUP.

Thank you to all  the people who helped make this experience!

Please check out the games made by the people who contributed!

Marble Quest by Wolf

Disinherited by Lighthoof Dryden

Bring Me Hope by Fern Nigro
